description: This file defines an interface for screen capture functionality within the WPEFramework project. It declares the IScreenCapture interface with methods for uploading and sending screenshots, along with notification callbacks for upload completion.

classes.name: IScreenCapture
classes.description: An interface for screen capture operations, including initiating uploads and handling notifications for upload completion.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for screen capture events.

methods.name: UploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Takes a screenshot and uploads it to the specified URL, returning the success status.

methods.name: SendScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot and uploads it, identified by a call GUID, returning the success status.

nested_classes.name: Result
nested_classes.description: Structure representing the success status of an upload or send operation.

nested_classes.name: INotification
nested_classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications when a screenshot upload is complete.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for screen capture events.

methods.name: UploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Initiates uploading a captured screen image to a specified URL.

methods.name: SendScreenshot
methods.description: Captures and uploads a screenshot associated with a specific call GUID.

methods.name: void UploadComplete(const bool & status,const string & message,const string & call_guid)
